findings.trigger: Profiling ledger write/URL parse failure during an owned __enter__/__exit__ return, or terminal ownership inspection failure.
findings.issue: Unprotected telemetry can escape the profile callback or finally, replace actual CLI status/error and interrupt ownership checking. At entry-return this risks preventing context acquisition/cleanup. It is not failure-safe passive instrumentation.
findings.requested_change: Non-raising finite secondary telemetry and atomic ledger writes; preserve real CLI error/cancellation and owned cleanup.

findings.trigger: Cancellation/wait error after Popen, or child exit racing watchdog killpg.
findings.issue: No unconditional known-child kill/reap finally; only TimeoutExpired is handled, and ProcessLookupError can skip reap/terminal evidence. Host probes also sample closure immediately rather than the existing bounded cleanup window.
findings.requested_change: Exact owned Popen cleanup finally, finite preserved primary cause and bounded closure observation, no nonzero signal to stale ledger grandchildren.

findings.trigger: Successful supported wrapper with row.code hash/length dictionaries.
findings.issue: Verifier treats each dictionary as raw hexadecimal and slices v[2:], which raises before closure verification.
findings.requested_change: Record validated sha256/bytes fields directly; do not claim wrapper preserves raw code bytes.

reviewed_scope: Actual runpy CLI dispatch and unchanged fixed plan32/skip12/150s runtime/source confirmed.
Host190s/no CPU-RSS sandbox limitation and e9 source/binary hashes checked offline.
Historical native006 raw source/receipts and supported wrapper layouts remain distinct.
limitations: No prelaunch authorization or historical CLI success is asserted.
CA digest is manifest-declared here; root prelaunch should verify with the exact executing locked Python certifi environment.
